tagline: Providing members with quality goods and services at the lowest possible prices
hero_kpi_rationale: Membership fees are at the core of Costco's business model, with 10% growth and fee increases. This recurring revenue stream, combined with a high renewal rate, fundamentally differentiates Costco from other retailers and supports its ultra-low pricing strategy on merchandise.

kpis.name: Comparable Sales Growth
kpis.explanation: Sales growth in warehouses open for more than one year
kpis.description: Measures sales growth in existing warehouses, reflecting member traffic and average basket size, excluding the impact of new store openings
kpis.signal: Indicator of organic business health excluding expansion

kpis.name: Net Sales
kpis.explanation: Total revenue including merchandise, fuel, and services
kpis.description: Total revenue generated from merchandise sales (food and non-food), ancillary services (fuel, pharmacy, optical), and e-commerce, net of Executive member discounts
kpis.signal: Overall volume of activity across all channels

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Gross margin as a percentage of net sales
kpis.description: Margin percentage after cost of goods sold, structurally low at Costco due to volume strategy, influenced by product mix and fuel proportion
kpis.signal: Gross commercial profitability, reflecting pricing power

kpis.name: Operating Income
kpis.explanation: Operating profit before taxes and financial expenses
kpis.description: Operating profit after deduction of all operating expenses (SG&A), including membership fees, reflecting the efficiency of the warehouse business model
kpis.signal: Overall operational profitability of the warehouse model

kpis.name: Membership Fee Revenue
kpis.explanation: Annual revenue generated from member fees
kpis.description: Fees paid by members (Business, Gold Star, Executive), a near-total margin revenue stream, driving profitability that enables low merchandise pricing
kpis.signal: Highly predictable and profitable recurring revenue

kpis.name: Number of Warehouses
kpis.explanation: Total number of warehouses operated worldwide
kpis.description: Global network of operational warehouses (United States, Canada, Mexico, Asia, Europe), with a standardized format of approximately 147,000 square feet per site
kpis.signal: Size of the physical network and pace of geographic expansion

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Consolidated net profit after taxes (effective tax rate of 25.1%), distributed to shareholders and reinvested in growth, reflecting total economic performance

kpis.name: E-commerce Sales Growth
kpis.description: Double-digit comparable growth in e-commerce sales, driven by operations in 8 countries (United States, Canada, Mexico, United Kingdom, Korea, Taiwan, Japan, Australia)
kpis.signal: Strong digital momentum despite channel maturity

kpis.name: U.S. and Canada Concentration
kpis.explanation: Proportion of sales generated in the United States and Canada
kpis.description: 86% of sales and 84% of operating income come from North America, with California alone representing 26% of U.S. sales, creating concentration risk
kpis.signal: High geographic dependence, particularly on California

kpis.name: Net International Openings
kpis.explanation: Net number of new warehouses outside the United States
kpis.description: 9 net international openings out of 24 total (Canada 2, Other 7), reflecting the strategy of accelerated growth in markets with higher potential and lower competition
kpis.signal: Acceleration of growth outside the home market

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale. Indicateur clé pour les investisseurs orientés revenus.
kpis.description: 5-year history of declared dividends per share (2021-2025).

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel du cash redistribué aux actionnaires : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions (treasury stock).
kpis.description: For 2025: cumulative dividends + share buybacks in billions USD.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du bénéfice net redistribuée en dividendes. Au-dessus de 80 % indique un dividende potentiellement non-soutenable.
kpis.description: Dividends / net income for 2025 (based on net income attributable to shareholders).

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Total revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Total revenue of $275.235 Bn in the last fiscal year (FY2025).

risks.title: Critical dependence on U.S. and Canadian operations
risks.score_rationale: Ranked as the top risk factor with alarming language ('materially adversely affect'). Represents 86% of sales and 84% of operating income. California concentration (26% of U.S. sales) amplifies exposure. Any shock in these markets directly impacts consolidated results. Maximum structural industry risk.

risks.title: Rising cyber threats and data breaches
risks.score_rationale: Highly alarming language on increasing attack sophistication (ransomware, phishing). Explicit mention of existential consequences: loss of member trust, massive regulatory penalties, high remediation costs. Detailed section with specific attack vectors. Explicit upward trend. Cybersecurity is critical.

risks.title: Failures of critical IT systems
risks.score_rationale: IT systems described as vital for transactions, inventory, and decision-making. Mention of ongoing large-scale investments increasing exposure to project failures. Severe operational consequences but less existential than cyber risk. Firm language ('could materially adversely affect'). Technology is central but not maximum.

risks.title: Non-compliance with strict personal data regulations
risks.score_rationale: Explicit reference to multiple regulations (GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, PCI DSS) with potentially high penalties. Handling of sensitive data (health, payment) is core to the model. Complexity increased by international expansion and remote work. High regulatory risk but not maximum as partially controllable.

risks.title: Growing obstacles to warehouse network expansion
risks.score_rationale: Strategic risk related to future growth: local regulations, community opposition, competition for premium sites, rising setup costs. Concerned language but no immediate urgency. Impact on long-term growth. Significant industry risk but not maximum.

risks.title: Erosion of trust in the Kirkland Signature brand
risks.score_rationale: Kirkland Signature represents an increasing share of sales and margins (strategic private label). Clear statement that loss of acceptability would significantly impact revenue and profitability. Reputation is critical for member loyalty. Moderate language but strategic stakes. High reputational risk but not maximum.

risks.title: Vulnerability to third-party payment systems and rising fees
risks.score_rationale: Dependence on third-party providers for card payments (critical). Mention of potential fee increases, service interruptions, and complex PCI DSS compliance. Direct financial impact but manageable. Moderate capital risk, less central than major operational risks.

ai_positioning.summary: No significant mention of artificial intelligence in Costco's 2025 annual report. The company does not disclose AI initiatives in its operations, customer relationships, or technology strategy.
